node.title: Re^3: date and time difference
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
My time zone is KST(South Korea republic), but when I executed following command in my system(openbsd),I got GMT time.

Which command do you mean? If you mean Perl's output, [doc://gmtime] will give you GMT, and [doc://localtime] will give you whatever the current time zone setting on that machine is. If you want more advanced functionality than that, then you need to switch to [mod://DateTime].

And thanks for your concern for using old version, but I can't not upgrade. It is not my authority.

Similar advice as in [id://693828] applies.
